jobs.description:
At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide.

About The Team:

Are you passionate about building food safety standards and driving product quality? We are looking for someone with technical experience to drive food safety and quality compliance.

Our Food Safety & Quality Assurance team is recruiting and we are looking for an experienced and highly driven Food Safety professional to join our international team. You will work within a team based across Europe to drive food safety and quality compliance with our Produce, Herbs & Fruit (PHF) suppliers, and work collaboratively with our procurement, sourcing, supply chain and distribution centre teams. The role will share best practice, create standardized ways of working, drive improvement in food safety & quality and lead on various strategic projects to ensure we delight our customers.

What You Will Be Doing:

You will...

- Perform on-site supplier visits and audits to manage their approval and drive strategic improvements in quality to decrease complaints and increase customer satisfaction
- Use your expertise and knowledge from industry and the supply base to develop best practice ways of working with your suppliers and internally
- Strategically manage supplier product quality and performance. Delivering focussed error (complaint) reduction initiatives and identifying projects that will improve our quality and safety standards
- Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure optimal performance
- Investigate and manage quality issues with suppliers to ensure customer availability and quality is not compromised with thorough root cause analysis and corrective action
- Own your category area to achieve key performance indicators relating to out of specification deliveries, customer complaints, and compliance metrics
- Manage and coordinate the onboarding of new suppliers and products ensuring compliance to food safety, legal and quality standards

Who You Are:

- 4+ years of experience in quality and food safety management, ideally within the produce industry
- Experience in auditing food manufacturers; additional food safety qualifications (e.g. HACCP, internal auditing) are highly desirable
- Willingness to travel, including some international trips; 50% of time spent at suppliers, distribution centres and the base office
- Excellent English communication and negotiation skills; pragmatic in solving time-sensitive issues - German skills are a big plus
- Confident decision-maker who remains calm under pressure and in challenging situations
- Thrives in a fast-paced environment with the ability to multitask across competing priorities
- Comfortable working with cross-functional and international teams across HelloFresh markets (UK, DACH, France, Nordics, BNL)
- intermediate to advanced skills in Google Suite / MS Office

What you will get in return:

● 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes
● Company pension scheme
● Gym membership
● Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)
● Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme
● Dog friendly office!
● Nursery support scheme
● Cycle to work scheme
● Group Life Assurance

Location: The HelloFresh Farm, 60 Worship Street, EC2A 2EZ, London

To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in the UK, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.

Hybrid Working Policy
We offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies to the role you're applying for, please consult with your recruiter.

Next steps: Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.

You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure environment, we will process Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) checks to the successful individual. Failure to disclose relevant information at application or throughout the process could affect your employment with the company.

jobs.occupation: ISV Sales Specialist, Google Cloud (German, English) (Business-Development-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
- 8 years of technology related sales, business development, channel sales, or partner management experience.
- Ability to communicate in German and English fluently to support client relationship management in this region

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience building business partnerships with enterprise Independent Software Vendors (ISV).
- Experience selling enterprise software solutions through Cloud Marketplaces.
- Experience working with, and managing, complex sales scenarios with multiple parties with differing goals.
- Experience creating new sales motions to scale best practices.
- Ability to work with customer engineers and customers' technical decision makers to secure a joint opportunity.

About the Job

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As an ISV Sales Specialist, you will support the jointGo-To-Market (GTM) success of Independent Software Vendor (ISV) partners, including generating, advancing, and closing co-sell opportunities alongside the Google Cloud field sales team through the Google Cloud Marketplace.  You will work with ISV partners to create region-specific sales motions to increase awareness of the ISV within the Google Cloud field team, generate new leads, and accelerate active opportunities.  You will work with Google Cloud customers to support the evaluation, procurement, and usage of ISV partner solutions.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €114000 - €116000 (EUR) + 66.67% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

- Build and grow relationships with existing ISV partners and customers by closing joint opportunities with Google cloud sales account teams and Google’s ecosystem.
- Develop regional co-sell plans and sales motions for ISV partners, working closely with cross-functional teams, including sales, customer engineers, and services teams.
- Drive sales plan achievement through ISV partner pipeline creation and reviews, ensuring sufficiency in pipeline creation, velocity, and win rate.
- Work with ISV partners, Google Cloud Sales teams, and customers to support transactions through the Google Cloud Marketplace, including distributor and reseller supported transactions.

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Discover Impactful Work

As a Sales Engineer Gauging within the Production Process & Analytics (PPA) business unit of the Chemical Analysis Division (CAD) at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will play a key role in driving commercial success across our Quality Control Systems portfolio.

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities while growing existing customer relationships across assigned industrial markets and territory. Reporting to the Global Commercial Leader, you will execute strategic sales initiatives, identify opportunities for market expansion, and deliver value-driven solutions that help customers improve their manufacturing processes.

Your technical expertise, consultative selling approach, and ability to build lasting customer partnerships will be essential in achieving sales objectives and supporting the continued growth and profitability of the business.

A Day in the Life:

- Achieve assigned bookings, revenue and profitability targets.
- Develop and execute territory sales plans to identify and secure new business opportunities.
- Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through quotation, negotiation and closing.
- Identify AI-enabled solutions and digital services to support business growth and deliver measurable customer value.
- Maintain an accurate sales forecast and opportunity pipeline using Salesforce.com.
- Collaborate with partners and representatives to support commercial growth.
- Provide valuable market intelligence by monitoring market trends, competitive activities and customer-specific requirements.
- Develop trusted relationships with existing and prospective customers.
- Analyze customer production processes and recommend technical solutions that improve quality, productivity and operational efficiency.
- Engage customers with AI-enabled discussions and commercial solutions.
- Deliver outstanding customer experience through responsiveness, technical expertise and solution-oriented support.
- Demonstrate and present the technical capabilities and business value of Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Quality Control Systems.
- Collaborate closely with application specialists, service engineers, software experts and product management to develop customer-specific solutions.
- Maintain a high level of product, application, industry and AI knowledge to effectively position our solutions.
- Travel throughout the assigned territory and internationally as required, with approximately 50% overnight travel.

What to expect:

- Drive sales growth by achieving commercial targets across the assigned territory.
- Identify and develop new business opportunities while expanding existing customer relationships.
- Lead complex technical sales engagements from prospecting through contract negotiation and closing.
- Deliver consultative, value-based sales solutions tailored to customer manufacturing processes.
- Work cross-functionally with technical experts, service teams and product management.
- Utilize Salesforce.com to manage opportunities, forecasting and customer engagement.
- Monitor market trends and competitive activities to support strategic business growth.
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific through regular customer visits and extensive travel.

Keys to Success:

Education

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent technical experience.

Experience

- Minimum of 3 years of successful technical sales experience in capital equipment, industrial instrumentation, process analytics or industrial automation.
- Proven experience selling complex technical solutions to manufacturing customers.
- Experience within one or more of the following industries is highly desirable:
- Metal
- Packaging & Converting
- Battery Manufacturing
- Experience working with distributors or channel partners is desirable.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Strong consultative selling and negotiation skills with a customer-focused mindset.
- Excellent presentation and communication skills for both technical and business audiences.
- Ability to understand complex manufacturing processes and translate them into customer-focused technical solutions.
- Understanding of AI and digital technologies as emerging commercial enablers within industrial markets.
- Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
- Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce.com preferred) together with digital sales and collaboration tools.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken).
- Additional language skills are an advantage.
- Valid driver's license and willingness to travel extensively.

Benefits:

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.

#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com (http://jobs.thermofisher.com)

Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!
OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK
We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCE

You assess current systems, infrastructure, and business processes to identify improvement opportunities and ensure compatibility with new solutions

- 
You collect and analyze stakeholder requirements to define solution scope and objectives

- 
You architect the Mercedes Pay Digital Voucher Solution, detailing structure, components, interfaces, and data flows, and select suitable technologies, platforms, and tools

- 
You create proof-of-concept projects to validate solutions and demonstrate feasibility

- 
You work with an experienced team of Solution Architects as well as the company's Enterprise, Cloud and Security Architects to derive right-fit solutions

- 
You facilitate the collaboration with external development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural guidelines and best practices

- 
You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex technical details into accessible language

- 
You document solutions and disseminate best practices among team members

Qualifikationen

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

- 
You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field

- 
You have 5+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, with a strong focus on software product development

- 
You have practical experience in at least one of the following domains: regulatory environments, agentic commerce, loyalty programs, vouchers, digital marketing, or payments (including PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, or AML/KYC)

- 
You are proficient in microservices, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, CI/CD), Auth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) protocols, alongside practices like Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and DevOps

- 
You have hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, GitHub, and Datadog

- 
You have a proven track record of implementing cutting-edge technologies within a corporate environment

- 
You possess strong teamwork and good communication skills, with the ability to maintain composure under pressure

- 
You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plus

OUR OFFER TO YOU

·       Modern and dynamic work environment

·       Flexible and mobile working

·       Attractive fitness offer

·       Numerous employee discounts

·       Excellent infrastructure

This is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:MER0003ZHV). For questions, please don’t hesitate to contact the HR Team of Mercedes pay GmbH: career_mercedespay@mercedes-benz.com

jobs.occupation: Assembly, Integration & Test Manager (m/f/d) for a Laser-Interferometric Instrument (Forschungs- und Entwicklungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Assembly, Integration & Test Manager (m/f/d) for a Laser-Interferometric Instrument

Payload Team

Due to our increased engagement in the area of laser interferometric instruments in collaboration with international partners and institutes, we are hiring new employees to strengthen our team in payload team.

Your tasks

- Serve as the primary responsible for instrument AIT for our next generation laser-interferometric instrument and direct point of contact for external partners
- Prepare, conduct and lead instrument test campaign
- Organize daily, monthly AIT schedule, personnel, and facilities
- Ensure timely delivery of hardware
- Coordinate, establish, and monitor AIT documentation; e.g. procedures, AIT flow, test reports
- Lead technical meetings and reviews (TRR, TRB), participate in NRB, progress meetings
- Review of subcontractor’s AIT documentation
- Collaborate with engineers across the company as part of the payload team
- Participation and organization of instrument at S/C level

Your skills and experience

- Professional experience of at least 5 years in the domain of AIT for space projects preferably Phase C/D
- Good understanding of laser-optical systems (e.g. laser, cavity) or electrical units (e.g. ICU) and instrument operation
- Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and foster a culture of inclusion
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English
- Master’s degree or PhD in Physics, Electronics, or a related engineering discipline
- Willingness and ability to travel within Europe, execute work in long-term missions as per environmental test campaign

We offer

- Diverse tasks in the area of high-end space technology
- Opportunity for personal impact and development possibilities in flat company hierarchies
- Living and working in an area of natural beauty and safety offering a large variety of leisure activities
- Profit sharing, company pension scheme, flexible home office rules and many more...

This position will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.

jobs.occupation: Chief Engineer (m/f/d) Business Unit Boeing, Telair International GmbH (Business-Unit Leiter/in)
jobs.description: Join us in shaping the aviation of tomorrow! As part of a globally operating group, we are among the world's leading companies in the development and production of innovative cargo solutions for the aviation industry. With passion, the highest standards of quality, and the courage to innovate, we create solutions that move the world and make us a strong partner to the most renowned aircraft manufacturers. Become part of our team in Miesbach and shape with us the future of aviation!   Chief Engineer (m/f/d) Business Unit Boeing YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES You take overall technical responsibility for all projects within the Business Unit Boeing. You lead and coordinate interdisciplinary engineering teams in alignment with the Vice President Engineering and the Business Unit Manager. You own the system architecture and define the technical solution strategy. You lead and coordinate interdisciplinary engineering teams. You ensure compliance with all requirements regarding quality, cost, schedule, and risk. You are accountable for requirements management, system design, integration, and verification & validation. You prepare and lead technical reviews (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR). You collaborate closely with project management, customers, partners, and certification authorities. You drive the continuous improvement of engineering processes, methods, and standards. YOUR QUALIFICATIONS As the ideal candidate, you hold a master's degree in electrical engineering or a comparable qualification. You have more than 5 years of professional experience within aerospace development and technical leadership. You have basic understanding of EASA Certification Rules (CS25) and Part21J regulations. You demonstrate strong analytical and conceptual skills. You show a high level of decision-making ability and excellent communication skills. You have experience in international projects; this is considered an advantage. You communicate confidently in English, and you benefit from additional German language skills. OUR BENEFITS Flexibility and Hybrid Working. We know that flexibility in the workplace is crucial. That's why we offer flexible working hours and hybrid working models, depending on the area of work. This allows you to balance your professional and personal life optimally. Personal Development. Stagnation? Not with us! We support your professional development through targeted training, further education opportunities, and educational leave. Your potential is our drive! Compensation and Benefits. In addition to performance-based compensation, we offer an attractive company-funded pension plan. You will also benefit from employee discounts and subsidies, such as for work clothing, safety shoes, and daily meals. Wellbeing.Your health and well-being are important to us! With offers like bike leasing through JobRad and access to Wellpass, we support you in staying active and healthy. Additionally, our employee assistance program meinEAP is available to provide professional help with health, professional, and personal challenges. Submit your application now with all required documents!

Job responsibilities:

- This role requires working on-site exclusively, with no other working option available.
- To confirm with all site quality management systems and health & safety procedures (ISO17025:2017, ISO15189:2012, GCLP, Human Tissue Act (2004))
- Monitor project progress and quality, effectively communicate with relevant teams/departments; ensure projects are delivered within the turnaround time (TAT) and meet the quality requirement
- Formulate and update the production plans according to projection, arrange pipeline to ensure smooth operation, optimize NGS protocols and automation of laboratory procedures.
- Instruct team leaders to carry out production data summary and statistical analysis. Ensure all relevant information are documented and archived. Be responsible for conducting department's reports.
- Establish responsibilities for members by roles and technical levels, supervise them to perform their duties
- Other tasks assigned by the line manager.

Requirements:

- A Master's or advanced degree in molecular biology, biochemistry, genetics, biotechnology, or similar subject is required, with a minimum of three-year laboratory experience.
- Experiences in leading a team of 5-10 members (minimum). Strong teamwork ethic and the commitment to successfully deliver to tight deadlines are essential.
- High accuracy and attention to detail are a must for both laboratory and office-based work.
- A strong and open communication skills is essential.
- Fluent operating Microsoft Office software including Word, Excel and PowerPoints is essential.
- Experience of using Laboratory information management systems (LIMS) is advantageous.
- Experience in PCR, qPCR and Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS)-based analysis is advantageous.
- Very good knowledge of German and English language, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Chinese will be an added advantage.

Anforderungen an den Bewerber: 
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Forschung, Botanik, Organische Chemie, Klinische Chemie, Hämatologie, Meeresbiologie, Histologie, Anthropologie, Dokumentation (technisch), Chemie
Expertenkenntnisse: Zellkulturforschung, Biomedizin, Versuchsplanung, Biologie, Biotechnologie, Bioverfahrenstechnik, Genetik, Immunhistochemie, Molekularbiologie, Medizinische Laborarbeiten, Zellbiologie, Bakteriologie, Immunhämatologie, Bakteriologische Untersuchungen, Gewebetypisierung, Serologie, Qualitätsprüfung, Qualitätssicherung, Gentechnologie, Biochemie, Mikrobiologie, Laborarbeiten, Labortechnik, Spektroskopie, Molekulare Landwirtschaft, Tierversuche, Labortierkunde

We are seeking an exceptional and highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our internationally active research group at the interface of cancer biology, neuroscience and tumor immunology.
Our group investigates how the nervous system shapes tumor initiation, progression, invasion, metastasis and cancer-associated symptoms, with a particular focus on pancreatic cancer and cancer neuroscience. We combine mechanistic cancer biology with neuroscience, immunology, advanced in vivo models, spatial and single-cell technologies, functional imaging and translational human studies.
Our ambition is clear: to define and lead emerging concepts in cancer neuroscience rather than merely follow them.
The laboratory operates in a highly competitive and well-funded environment with support from, among others, the European Research Council (ERC), Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG), Deutsche Krebshilfe and Else Kröner-Fresenius-Stiftung, and is embedded in a strong national and international network in cancer neuroscience.

München | As soon as possible | Full-/Part-time | Fixed-term (36 months)

The successful candidate will take a central scientific role in our experimental program and will contribute to the conception, execution and development of ambitious projects addressing neural-tumor-immune interactions.

mechanistic studies of neuron-cancer and neuro-immune interactions

genetically engineered and orthotopic in vivo tumor models
manipulation of neuronal, immune and tumor-cell populations
advanced imaging and molecular phenotyping
integration of molecular, cellular and spatial data with functional experiments
development of new experimental concepts and therapeutic strategies in cancer neuroscience

A particularly important aspect of the position is the strategic management and further development of our animal experimentation platform.

This may include:

preparation and coordination of animal study applications and amendments
planning and supervision of complex in vivo experiments
establishment and optimization of experimental mouse models
management of genetically modified mouse colonies
breeding strategy, genotyping and colony planning
coordination with animal facilities, authorities and collaborating laboratories
implementation of high standards in experimental design, documentation and animal welfare
We are looking for a scientist with a strong experimental background in at least one - preferably several - of the following fields: Cancer Biology | Tumor Immunology | Neuroscience | Neuroimmunology | Molecular Biology

You should have:

a PhD or equivalent doctoral degree in a relevant life-science discipline
substantial hands-on experience in experimental biomedical research as well as experience with in vivo models, ideally tumor models and/or neuroscience models
strong expertise in molecular and cellular biology and the ability to independently design, troubleshoot and drive complex experiments
excellent scientific communication skills in English
a highly collaborative but intellectually independent working style

Particularly desirable is extensive experience with:

animal experimentation and experimental planning and preparation or management of animal experimentation applications
genetically engineered mouse models as well as mouse breeding and colony management
tumor models and neuroscience or neuroimmunology techniques

This is not intended to be a purely technical postdoctoral position.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for managing the cost-effective supply of materials & services in line with company processes based on customer requirements, while maintaining safety, quality and on-time delivery standards. Internally, you will provide an excellent customer orientated procurement service to support our Order Winning, Operations, Project Management, Engineering and Finance teams.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Drive cost savings and supplier performance in line with Grid Technology’s business goals
* Lead supplier negotiations and contract management, ensuring performance, compliance, safety and customer satisfaction
* Promote digitalization, AI-driven procurement efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop strategic supplier relationships, implement supplier development programs and optimize supplier performance through scorecards and regular reviews
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, project management, legal, operations and order management, ensuring stakeholder alignment and transparency
* Identify and mitigate supply chain risks, define BU-specific product strategies in line with Siemens Energy Guidelines and collaborate with commodity management to optimize market opportunities and purchasing volumes

What You Bring

* University degree in supply chain, business or a related field
* Long-term relevant professional experience in procurement with engineered products or service provision in a project environment; preferably in international sourcing
* Experience in service or project business and excellent understanding of contract law
* Advanced analytical, negotiation, stakeholder management and communication skills, with excellent English and ideally German language skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, SAP and analytical tools, with proven success in digital transformation initiatives
* Customer-focused, collaborative and self-motivated working style, with attention to detail, flexibility, prioritization, urgency, problem-solving, decision-making and continuous improvement skills

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* Neben einem attraktiven, marktgerechten Vergütungspaket erwartet Sie eine attraktive arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersversorgung
* Daneben bieten wir die Möglichkeit, zu sehr interessanten Mitarbeiterkonditionen Aktionär*in von Siemens Energy zu werden
* Unter unserem Motto #BetterTogether bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden die Möglichkeit, flexibel und auch remote zu arbeiten. Aber auch unsere Büros lassen keine Wünsche offen und bieten Raum für inspirierende Zusammenarbeit und Kreativität
* Die berufliche und auch persönliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden ist uns ein großes Anliegen. Sie haben bei uns die Möglichkeit selbstbestimmt zu lernen und sich zu entwickeln. Dafür stehen unterschiedliche attraktive Programme und Maßnahmen zur Verfügung
* Unter dem Aspekt "Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf" haben wir ein vielfältiges Angebot, z.B. flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Kinderbetreuungsplätze an vielen Standorten, die Möglichkeit zur Schnupperteilzeit oder auch ein Sabbatical
